description: The tool lists worksites in one state and one NAICS trade code in name order, never by rate. It shows each worksite's three-year rate, range, and hours. You can use the list to build a shortlist for vetting, then read each worksite's own record.

limit.description: How many results to return, 25 at most.

min_hours.description: Leave out worksites with fewer total hours over the three years.

offset.description: How many results to skip for the next page.

name: find_contractors
title: Find worksites in a trade
